Active CPT: CPT-1 · WT = 1.70 m below surface · parameter source = EC7 / NEN Table 3 · Stage 5 tuned m = used where accepted
Settlement
SLS settlement at the footing / slab centreline from CPT-derived E_oed with explicit stress integration below Df.
INPUTS
The reported settlement is the vertical settlement beneath the centre of the loaded area. For a strip footing this is the centreline in section; for a rectangular, square, circular footing or slab it is the middle of the footprint.

Strip
Rectangular / slab
Square
Circular

Stress spread
Boussinesq / Newmark
2:1 method
Truncation rule
Delta sigma < 10% sigma'v0
Delta sigma < 20% q_net
Use CPT bottom
Sub-layer dz (m)
Target allowable settlement (mm)
Show settlement time curve

FORMULA USED
Delta eps = Delta sigma_v / E_oed(sigma_mean)
Delta S = Sum(Delta eps * Delta z)
Evaluation point = centre of loaded area
Stress method = Boussinesq / Newmark centreline
Soil route = Characteristic E_oed,ref and m
Load route = SLS quasi-permanent
Truncation = CPT bottom reached
